description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the scalp of an individual with diffuse purpuric discoloration. The affected area appears to involve the central and posterior scalp, with irregularly distributed dark red to purple patches. The surrounding skin shows no overt signs of swelling or ulceration. Sparse hair is visible, and no other lesions are apparent in this image.
visible_findings: irregularly distributed dark red to purple patches

description.short_caption: Dusky discoloration and purpura on the nose.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the nose of a patient with dusky, violaceous discoloration and areas of purpura. The lesions are irregularly distributed, with some darker areas suggestive of necrosis. The surrounding skin appears mottled, and there is no visible ulceration or active bleeding. The findings are consistent with vascular compromise or a vasculitic process.
